guard: aggregate mutation coverage examines the full selection, recognizes supported execution paths and summaries, reports every outcome with the exact tree, and fails after rather than during incomplete grading
why: Each mutation removes one public guarantee from the aggregate validator. The self-test drives throwaway repositories through the real command entrypoint, so the mutated script is the code under test rather than a copied helper.

The continuation mutation restores the first-error abort. The subprocess mutation restores the false refusal for declared entrypoints. The two parser mutations restore the completed-but-ungraded outputs reproduced by real suites. The final mutation makes incomplete grading look green again.

mutations.name: a refused config aborts the process before later configs are examined
mutations.expectRed: one bad config does not hide later configs
mutations.cell: one bad config does not hide later configs

mutations.name: declared subprocess entrypoints are ignored
mutations.find: if (executedWitness(cfg.suite, source, cfg.command, mutation, cfg.executes ?? [])) return;
mutations.replace: void executedWitness(cfg.suite, source, cfg.command, mutation, cfg.executes ?? []);
mutations.expectRed: a spawned repo entrypoint plus target-package build is gradable
mutations.cell: a spawned repo entrypoint plus target-package build is gradable

mutations.name: completed all-passed fractions are not parsed
mutations.find: if (fraction && Number(fraction[1]) === Number(fraction[2])) return { executed: Number(fraction[2]), failures: 0 };
mutations.expectRed: a completed all-passed fraction supplies the executed total
mutations.cell: a completed all-passed fraction supplies the executed total

mutations.name: completed progress-marker suites are not parsed
mutations.find: if (completed && executed >= cfg.minTicks) return { executed, failures: 0 };
mutations.expectRed: anchored progress plus an explicit completion marker supplies a total
mutations.cell: anchored progress plus an explicit completion marker supplies a total

mutations.name: incomplete aggregate grading exits successfully
mutations.find: if (refused || unparsed || failed || examined !== configs.length || graded !== configs.length) process.exitCode = 1;
mutations.replace: void refused; void unparsed; void failed; void examined; void graded;
mutations.expectRed: zero failures without a total stays unparsed
mutations.cell: zero failures without a total stays unparsed

mutations.name: the audit summary omits the checkout tree
mutations.find: `MUTATION COVERAGE SUMMARY head=${head} enumerated=${configs.length} examined=${examined} graded=${graded} ` +
mutations.replace: `MUTATION COVERAGE SUMMARY head=unknown enumerated=${configs.length} examined=${examined} graded=${graded} ` +
mutations.expectRed: the audit summary names the exact checkout tree
mutations.cell: the audit summary names the exact checkout tree
